cards.name: Qubeley
cards.effect:
【Once per Turn】During your turn, when you pair a Pilot with one of your Units, deploy 1 to 2 [Bit / Funnel]((Long-Range Weapon)･AP2･HP2･This Unit can't be paired with a Pilot or attack) Unit tokens.
【Activate･Main】【Once per Turn】①：Choose 1 of your Unit tokens and 1 enemy Unit. Begin a battle between them and only perform the damage step.

faqs.q: What does "Begin a battle between them and only perform the damage step" mean?
faqs.a: Begin a battle between the two Units specified by this effect and perform the damage step. Do not perform the attack step, block step, or action step at this time. Like a normal battle, the Units deal damage to each other, and after resolving all triggered effects you advance to the battle end step before returning to the main phase.

faqs.q: When I use this effect to begin a battle with an enemy GD02-073 Carta's Graze Ritter (Ground Type), does its "During your opponent's turn, the enemy Unit battling this Unit gains <First Strike>" effect activate?
faqs.a: Yes, it does. Effects that activate during battle apart from effects like 【Attack】 and "When [...] attacks" activate even during battles initiated by effects.

faqs.q: When I destroy an enemy Unit in a battle initiated by this effect, does that fall within the criterion "when this Unit destroys an enemy Unit with battle damage"?

cards.name: GFreD
cards.effect: 【Deploy】If 4 or more enemy Units are in play, look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal 1 Pilot card among them and add it to your hand. Return the remaining cards randomly to the bottom of your deck.

faqs.q: Can I choose not to activate this 【Deploy】 effect even if there are four or more enemy Units in play?
faqs.a: No. If there are four or more enemy Units in play, you are forced to activate this effect up to and including the portion "look at the top 5 cards of your deck." Whether or not you add eligible cards among them to your hand is your choice.
